blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Electoral Tribunal on Friday dismissed once again an amended version of the quo warranto petition to unseat Sen. Erwin Tulfo. This type of petition challenges a person’s right to hold a public office. Berteni Causing filed this case versus Tulfo on grounds of supposed “disloyalty to the Philippines and allegiance to the United States of America,” and his reported ineligibility due to alleged non-Filipino citizenship. Causing also said the senator belongs to a political dynasty, and that he lacks academic qualifications. “The Tribunal DENIED the Motion for Reconsideration with Amended Petition for Quo Warranto, without prejudice […]...
